text: For a structured 'simple game' whose reward matrix has r all-ones rows R plus an eps-scaled perturbation, the authors show that a row player using Algorithm 1 places total mass at most eps T + O(sqrt(T ln N)) on actions outside R. Corollary 7 then bounds its swap regret by 2 eps T + O(r sqrt(T ln N)).
title: Corollary 7: swap regret without an N penalty in structured games likened to debate
